risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- About 80 MTPA of cement capacity has been added industry-wide in the last two financial years against installed capacity of ~715 MTPA versus consumption of ~500 MTPA, with further additions of ~70 MTPA in FY27 and ~270 MTPA between 2027-2031, keeping industry utilisation around 72-73%.
- Flagged by the Company as a major risk applicable to the industry, including amendments to the MMDR Act.
- Flagged by the Company as a major applicable industry risk alongside mining regulatory issues.
- The ongoing West Asia conflict may raise energy, fuel, freight and raw-material costs (petcoke, coal, crude oil), pressuring industry margins and profitability.
- Cement prices remained under pressure for most of the year due to intense competition and the fragmented nature of the industry, shrinking operating margins across the sector.
- The Company's ability to further increase blended cement production is constrained by the limited availability of viable fly ash and slag in the region.
- The paints industry faces cost pressures from volatility in crude-oil-linked raw materials, titanium dioxide imports, logistics costs and exchange fluctuations, along with intensified pricing competition and softer urban demand impacting margins and profitability.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Continued focus on operating efficiencies and cost optimization, including lower power consumption and higher captive power generation.
- Increased focus on blended cement to raise blended cement volumes, constrained by limited regional availability of viable fly ash and slag.
- Strengthening the portfolio of high-value paint products that contribute significantly to overall business performance.
- Widening the paints distribution network and appointing new dealers to raise sales volume and improve product mix.
